messages:
Evan (Sales): NovaHealth intake: they want an on-prem private deployment in an isolated VPC, strict zero egress, HSM (FIPS), immutable logs retained 365 days. They asked for a go-live date to include in the MSA (~6 weeks). Can product confirm a feasible plan?
Priya (Product): Copy. Need model sizes/QPS and whether customer will provision infra or want us to. Also need compliance note (HIPAA).
Evan (Sales): They said model family flexible, target low-medium QPS, will provide site ops and can provision hardware if we give an exact spec. HIPAA required.
Marco (Solutions Eng): Recommend phased delivery: Phase 1 = infra & HSM onboarding + smoke tests, Phase 2 = scale/observability + SLA checks, Phase 3 = tuning + runbook. 6 weeks only if customer pre-provisions GPUs and HSM ceremony happens Week 1.
Jin (Infra): Short checklist for Sales/legal: GPUs (A100 40/80GB or H100), storage 42TB baseline, model artifact import process (signed tar), ops VPN, no outbound required. If we need to image/procure, add 4 weeks.
Rhea (Security): Non-negotiables: FIPS-validated HSM, documented key ceremony, append-only audit store, retention 365 days, incident response clause. Need confirmation on whether any telemetry is allowed.
Evan (Sales): Customer confirms zero egress and will provide site engineer. They want a single-page dependency list for SOW.
Priya (Product): I'll draft the one-pager acceptance criteria & dependencies: HSM import validated, smoke tests pass, logs retained 365 days, canary at agreed QPS, security signoff. Jin/Rhea/Marco please add technical signoffs by EOD.
DeployBot: ticket created -> INFRA-7641 "NovaHealth on-prem intake: airgap + HSM" (assignee: Jin)
Marco (Solutions Eng): I'll attach a minimal smoke-test plan and model compatibility notes.
Jin (Infra): Will validate exact ports, storage numbers, and GPU SKU by EOD tomorrow.
Rhea (Security): Will share key ceremony template and contract language for retention.
Priya (Product): If no objections, we'll send phased SOW and recommend earliest full prod Week 8 contingent on customer readiness. Evan to set expectations with the customer. :thumbsup:
